messages.content: We're a week out. Can you reconcile all three confirmations and make sure the deposits, deadlines, and arrival details line up?

They line up for October 4-9. Flights SD4K9Q are ticketed for Maya Chen and Jordan Lee, with $1,142 posted. La Jolla LJ731026 covers October 4-7 for both guests at $1,224.11; no deposit was required. Little Italy LI492706 covers October 7-9 for both guests at $725.60; its $362.80 deposit has posted. Rental RC61835 runs Friday through Monday and remains estimated at $284, with payment due at pickup.
What are the exact cancellation cutoffs now? Include the rental and tell me whether any old La Jolla charge is hanging around.

La Jolla remains refundable through today, September 27, at 6:00 p.m. Pacific. Little Italy is refundable through Friday, October 4, at 4:00 p.m. Pacific. The rental can be canceled without charge through its scheduled Friday pickup time. The former La Jolla booking LJ730184 was canceled without penalty, and there is no deposit or residual charge from it.
Good. What do we do if the Friday flight is late, and what should we expect at the rental counter?

The La Jolla confirmation says to call the front desk if arrival will be after 10:00 p.m.; its 24-hour number is 619-555-0148. The rental paperwork lists the airport counter at 619-555-0186 and asks delayed customers to call before the counter closes at 11:30 p.m. Bring the renter's license and the payment card used to reserve. The estimated $284 is not posted yet; a temporary card authorization may be placed at pickup.
And Monday? I want the handoff spelled out, especially since early access isn't guaranteed.

Check out of La Jolla Monday morning, drive downtown, and return the car at 12:30 p.m. under RC61835. Then take the two suitcases to Little Italy; luggage storage is acknowledged even if the room is not ready. Early room access remains unconfirmed. For arrival issues, the Little Italy front desk is staffed around the clock at 619-555-0122.
Put the whole thing in a compact chronological itinerary, including Wednesday departure and the money status.

Fri Oct 4: fly to San Diego under SD4K9Q; collect rental RC61835, then check in at La Jolla under LJ731026. Call the hotel after 10:00 p.m. if delayed. Mon Oct 7: check out, return the rental downtown at 12:30 p.m., store two bags at Little Italy, and check in under LI492706 when the room is available. Wed Oct 9: check out, request a rideshare around 2:30 p.m., and depart SAN nonstop at 5:35 p.m. Posted: $1,142 airfare plus $362.80 Little Italy deposit, totaling $1,504.80. Still projected: $1,224.11 La Jolla, $362.80 Little Italy balance, $434 combined transportation, and $140 checked bags. Projected trip total remains $3,665.71 including bags.
